verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV runs as a drop-in flow inside Plaid Link, with client callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess) and STATUS_UPDATED/STEP_UPDATED webhooks for tracking progress and results. The product page covers ID document authentication plus liveness/face match against the ID, and templates combine these checks without custom capture UI. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the server-side session/token creation call, a hosted redirect (non-embedded) option, a documented API for retrieving verification results, and independent hands-on corroboration.
